title: MEIKO — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku, MEIKO & Luka
rows.Line: ♪ーーーーーーーー!!!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's only the first song and it's already nuts!>
<You're so cool, MEIKO!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Are you all ready to raise the roof?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone here is so energetic. And...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Good! To! Go!>
<I love you MEIKO!!!>
<Looking forward to it!!!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're reading the comments, too! It seems like everyone watching the stream is ready.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you! Now, let's get this show on the road!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: MEIKO's anniversary show starts now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: ♪ーーーーーーーー!!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Phew.
Thanks for getting pumped up, everybody!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thanks to you too, Miku, Luka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now... Time to share today's concept with everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The concept for this show is... “The Coolest Me I Can Be!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want everyone who's gathered to celebrate with me to see the coolest MEIKO in history!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? You already see that every day?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. What I want to show you today will blow that right out of the water!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, before the show started, we had you fill out a survey about which songs you think I'm the coolest while singing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I had a look at every one, and Miku, the others and I came up with a setlist!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, everyone here in the venue and all of you at home! Burn this sight into your eyes!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, Rin, Len!
Let's jump right into the next one!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We're going nonstop from here, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's hype it up with MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Let's heat this place up!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Start the music!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO! Thanks for joining me for the last song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was an honor to join you for the finale.
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You both did so well!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What did you think, everyone?
MEIKO was the coolest today that she's ever been!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all were here to see it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, everyone, and all of you who answered our survey... And everyone who got things hyped up! Thank you for giving me so much strength today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's thanks to you that we were able to hold this show, to share this amazing time together, and I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad we could help with such an amazing show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you should know, we have one more present for you today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Another present?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. We wanted to be sure our feelings came across properly, so we all prepared messages for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO. I hope you accept these feelings of gratitude.
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's so amazing how you face each and every fan head-on to be the very best you can be for them. Let's do another show together soon!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, MEIKO!
Your show today was the coolest!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I got the choreography you taught me down perfectly for the chorus! Did you see? Hehehe, let's sing together again soon♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Congrats, MEIKO! Singing with you today really reminded me how I want to be as cool as you are someday!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll keep working on my singing power and impact, so just watch me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO. You're always so dependable and we're so grateful for everything you've done for us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course, that includes me too. I'm sure I'll keep leaning on you from time to time, but if you ever need help with anything, let me know.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
MEIKO, congratulations!
Your anniversary show was amazing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You always shine, but when you're on stage, you're even more brilliant than usual. I'm sure all your fans noticed it, too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm so glad we were able to contribute to such an important show for you. Here's to many more!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for the wonderful messages, everyone. The show isn't even over, and I'm already tearing up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to watch today's show, everyone! Personally, I think it came out great. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's nothing better than sharing this time with all of you through song!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And it's all thanks to the moment you first encountered my music.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for finding me, everyone. I hope we'll get to be together like this for a long time to come.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope so too, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Oh no, now I'm tearing up too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, don't cry. Look how hard MEIKO's holding her tears back.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, Luka! Don't remind me about it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm going to pay you all back plenty once we're done here, so be ready!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's the end of our show today, everyone. I hope you'll come listen to us again sometime soon!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much!
Let's meet again. Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Bye bye!
